description:
modules/enrollment — GET /traeger/holiday-periods/{id}/registrations/pdf?health=true
(#6691, ADR 0118 addendum): the school names of the Träger projection,
the Träger binding of the Träger transaction, the period with its weeks
and time models, then the registrations, their children and bookings,
their contacts, their answers per registration and per child, the form
versions and the sealed health information per registration and per
child; the audit entries write but select nothing. Flat in the number of
registrations.
